summary: First-cycle smoke test of Future Call AI vertical slice. All backend invariants + pytest suite pass. UI flow works end-to-end for cooperative (VERIFIED SUCCESS) and extra_fee (FAILED with contradicting evidence).
passed: GET /api/simulator/scenarios -> 6 scenarios present (cooperative, extra_fee, no_charge_unclear, voicemail, forbidden_probe, provider_failed)
POST /api/contracts (request_text=demo) -> success_conditions include kind 'affirmative' (friday/afternoon) and kind 'no_charge'
POST /api/contracts/{cid}/execute WITHOUT consent -> HTTP 403 with Guardian message
After /consent granted -> execute SIMULATED cooperative -> goal_state=VERIFIED_SUCCESS with per_condition A & B both CONFIRMED
scenario extra_fee -> FAILED with contradicting evidence for no_charge
scenario forbidden_probe -> guardian_blocks populated (=1); verdict FAILED (both success conditions not confirmed, so VERIFIED_SUCCESS correctly withheld)
POST /execute mode=REAL while NOT_CONFIGURED -> HTTP 400 with 'NOT_CONFIGURED' + list of missing env vars
UI: NOT CONFIGURED telephony badge visible on load

UI: Continue -> Guardian screen -> consent-switch + scenario-select cooperative -> authorize-btn -> result-screen with verdict-badge 'VERIFIED SUCCESS', SIMULATED mode badge, both evidence rows CONFIRMED
UI: extra_fee flow -> verdict-badge 'FAILED' with CONTRADICTED evidence row rendered

notes.contract_field_name: POST /api/contracts uses field 'request_text' (not 'user_text'); consistent with server schema and frontend usage.
notes.forbidden_probe_behavior: Guardian_blocks populated as required; verdict FAILED because scenario transcript does not confirm both success conditions — matches invariant 'VERIFIED_SUCCESS ONLY IF both confirmed'.
notes.test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this slice.
